sentences.en: All you do is devalue me as a person.
sentences.zh: 你所做的只是贬低我这个人。

sentences.en: The Algerian dinar is devaluing year after year.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚第纳尔一年接一年地贬值。

sentences.en: Self-centered people like to devalue others.
sentences.zh: 以自我为中心的人喜欢贬低他人。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（去掉）+val（价值）+ ue→去掉价值→贬值
